title: Categories with >20% month-over-month growth in 2025
prompt: Which product categories had month-over-month revenue growth greater than 20% in any month of 2025?
population: Completed orders from Dec 2024 through Aug 2025 (the prior month is needed to compute January 2025's growth), joined to order_items and products.
grain: One row per product category per month, for 2025 months only, in the final result.
metricDefinition: month-over-month revenue growth rate = (this month's category revenue − previous month's) / previous month's revenue, filtered to > 20%.
transformationPlan: aggregate order_items to category × month revenue (include Dec 2024 for the January comparison)
order by month within each category and get the previous month's revenue via LAG
filter to 2025 months where growth exceeds 20%
referenceSql: WITH category_month AS (SELECT p.category, date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-12-01' GROUP BY p.category, date_trunc('month', o.order_date)), with_growth AS (SELECT category, month, revenue, lag(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue FROM category_month) SELECT category, month, revenue, prev_revenue, (revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue AS growth_rate FROM with_growth WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND (revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue > 0.20 ORDER BY category, month

commonWrongAnswers.sql: WITH category_month AS (SELECT p.category, date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category, date_trunc('month', o.order_date)) SELECT category, month, revenue, lag(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue FROM category_month
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Excludes December 2024, so January 2025's LAG has no previous value to compare against — the first real month of growth silently drops out.
